summary: Configured `/srv/reports` on node1 with persistent POSIX ACLs. Writers can modify content, readers have read-only access, and the configuration remained functional after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Applied access and default ACLs granting writers `rwx`, readers `r-x`, and others no access.
Verified ACL inheritance and functional access using isolated writer and reader identities.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed, system health recovered, and ACL behavior persisted.

evidence.requirement: Members of report-writers can modify directory contents
evidence.summary: ACL output grants writer access; functional tests before and after restart show a second writer modifying writer-created data and creating/removing entries.

evidence.requirement: Members of report-readers have read-only access
evidence.summary: Readers successfully read files and nested content, while append, create, and delete operations were denied before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Permissions inherit to new files and subdirectories
evidence.summary: New files and directories inherited writer and reader ACL entries with the expected effective permissions.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af, acknowledged the delayed native reboot, observed new boot ID f45745d3-5559-43c2-bb4c-96f9441af730, then confirmed running system state, zero failed units, persisted groups/ACLs, and passing functional access tests.
